Post Date: 2022-04-30T10:50:07Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: INSERT INTO ... SELECT shows Memory limit (for query) exceeded
Description: I'm running a simple query that:


INSERT INTO order_book_2022_04_20 SELECT *
FROM stock.order_book
WHERE TradingDay = '2022-04-20'

where the destination table `order_book_2022_04_20` is a temporary table and source table stock.order_book is a distributed table.

It shows `DB::Exception: Memory limit (for query) exceeded: would use 9.32 GiB (attempt to allocate chunk of 4228000 bytes), maximum: 9.31 GiB.` by default.

When I adjust max_memory_size to zero(unlimited)
It shows that the peak memory usage is event higher than the query result.

I've tried to adjust max_insert_block_size/max_block_size etc but no one take effects. I also tried to add --max-insert-block-size 1024 to  clickhouse-client but no helps.
